description:
Fetch OHLCV candles (open/high/low/close/volume, UTC bar times). No api_key. USDT perpetual pairs. exchange is binance, bybit, or okx; symbol like BTCUSDT, one of get_available_pairs for that exchange (unlisted or malformed symbols are refused); timeframe is 1m, 3m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 1d, or 1w (not interval). query_candles and calculate_indicator may require x402 USDC payment when enabled — invalid args are rejected before payment, and a tool error is never settled, so it costs nothing.

PAID TOOL — 0.005 USDC per call, over x402 (eip155:8453). Call it once without payment: the answer carries the exact payment requirements. Sign them and call again with the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]. You are charged only when the call succeeds.
name: query_candles
title: Query Candles
